title: PROTO — Proverbs & Tacit-knowledge Ontology
description:
An OWL ontology and accompanying dataset modeling proverbs, the tacit (unspoken) lessons they carry, the situations in which they are used, and the cross-cultural equivalences that link a proverb in one language to a proverb in another when they teach the same lesson but diverge (or don't) in imagery.

Includes the TBox (proto-ontology-structure.ttl), the ABox generated from a 28-proverb, 4-language dataset (proto_data.ttl), the source spreadsheet, and the conversion script.
